## Key Projects

### ALReserve (2026–Present) — https://alreserve.com
Live membership-based luxury accommodation booking platform for GCC travelers. TypeScript monorepo (Bun): React 19, AdonisJS 7, PostgreSQL, Redis, Meilisearch. Four hotel supply providers behind one layer, fail-open Redis caching, Revolut payments. Self-hosted on Hetzner (Coolify, Traefik, Woodpecker CI, Prometheus/Grafana). Measured 30-day uptime in November 2026: 100% website, 99.99% API.

### Regional Church System (2023–Present)
Multi-tenant Arabic RTL church management platform serving 24 churches with 1,000+ daily users. Built with Laravel, FilamentPHP, Livewire, MySQL, Meilisearch, Redis, and Docker.

### Nassaq / نسق (2025–2026)
Graduation project (rated Excellent): exam-timetabling desktop app for a university exam office. Cut final-exam scheduling from about 4 weeks of manual work to under 3 minutes. Python, OR-Tools CP-SAT, FastAPI, React, Tauri.

### Hessah System (2024–2025)
Experimental SaaS for private tutors (attendance, payments, exam analytics, parent notifications), built to test the idea and never launched. Laravel, FilamentPHP, Livewire.

### Taswib / تصويب (2026) — https://github.com/deviengeorge/taswib
Open-source Windows tray app that fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout (Arabic and English) with one key. C#, .NET 8, Velopack auto-update. MIT licensed.

### sshm (2026) — https://github.com/deviengeorge/sshm
Open-source Bash CLI for SSH with Bitwarden-stored credentials, tunnel presets, and multi-tunnel support.
